description: Reproducible model for analyzing perfect competition vs. strategic behaviour from hydropower in the spot and forward markets is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Viviane Aubin. This dataset supports the reproduction of the analysis of interactions between the spot and forward markets, in cases of perfect competition or strategic behaviour by hydropower. It is presented in the associated paper "Long-term contracts in hydro-rich power systems: between market power, regulation, and resource adequacy" (see Related links). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
